description: This file defines classes and templates related to tunable CUDA operations in PyTorch, including profiling, numerical stability, and operator registration for performance tuning.

classes.name: Callable
classes.description: Abstract base class for callable tunable operations with support check.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Class for calculating running statistics like variance and standard deviation.

classes.name: FixedSizeStack
classes.description: A fixed-size stack for storing recent strings, used for top solutions.

classes.name: TunableOp
classes.description: Template class for managing and tuning CUDA operations, including profiling and operator registration.

classes.name: OpParams
classes.description: Abstract base class for operation parameters, including signature methods.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the tunable operation, performing lookup, tuning, or default execution.

methods.name: Signature
methods.description: Returns a string signature of the operator, with lazy initialization.

methods.name: RegisterOp
methods.description: Registers a new operation with a name and implementation.

methods.name: ProfileSimple
methods.description: Profiles operation execution time over multiple iterations.

methods.name: ProfileStats
methods.description: Profiles operation execution time and computes statistics.

methods.name: FindFastest
methods.description: Profiles and determines the fastest operator configuration for given parameters.

methods.name: CreateSignature
methods.description: Creates a demangled string signature of the class type.
